implementation: ECDSA for ID-One Cosmo v7 N
description: The ID-One Cosmo Smart Card Platform is a single chip multi-application that offers a highly secure architecture together with enhanced cryptographic services. The tested algorithm implementation applies to the following hardware part number: B0, BA, C8, CA, CB, C4, C7, C9, B7, CD, C6, with firmware version FC10.

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
